# VPN Troubleshooting / Stage 1 — Peer Reachability / Stage 2 — IKE Negotiation / Stage 3 — IPsec Negotiation

When a VPN fails, separate the problem into stages.

Verify:

- Peer IP
- Routing
- WAN connectivity
- Upstream firewall behavior

Verify:

- IKE version
- Authentication
- Proposal
- Diffie-Hellman group
- Lifetime
- Peer identity

Verify:

- IPsec proposal
- PFS
- Traffic selectors
- Proxy IDs
- Lifetime
